defect: Optional compaction could pass difference-edge and hard-term checks before output rounding but violate exact physical separation on emitted coordinates. The earlier pose was then discarded instead of being reconsidered.
change: Retain the pre-compaction pose until output-grid checks pass. On an exact-grid failure, restore that pose, round it using the existing accounted operation, and independently recheck exact separation, edges and hard terms. All subsequent occupancy and publication checks remain active. A restored pose that still fails is rejected.
policy: No distance, clearance, collision tolerance, electrical requirement, output precision or search budget changed. Failed compaction and restoration remain in diagnostics; executed scalar operations remain accounted. This fixes incumbent preservation, not search completeness.

tests.new_coverage: Decimal-boundary fixture family contains successful exact-grid restorations. Independently verify restored separation and hard terms, equality with the successful noncompacting incumbent, and reproducibility of poses, diagnostic logs and operation counts. Existing strict-contact rejection remains active.

discarded_prototype.strategy: After a rejected seed-adjusted joint solution, qualify the original Bellman solution through the same finish path.
discarded_prototype.result: Both smaller outlines still failed; 165x159 retained the reference PCB hash. No demonstrated benefit; prototype removed.

scope: Both-board construction regressions, not fresh full qualification or a matched performance benchmark. Timing samples overlapped test/build work and do not support speedup claims. No new smaller carrier accepted. Goal remains incomplete.
